latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Meeting Minutes skill for structured, actionable internal meeting notes.

- Generates concise meeting minutes for internal meetings up to 60 minutes, prioritizing decisions and action items.
- Strict, detailed schema ensures standardized output with metadata, attendance, agenda, decisions, action items (owner & due date), notes, unresolved items, risks, and attachments.
- Built-in workflow for intake, capture, drafting, review, and publishing, including clarifying questions if information is missing.
- Style guidelines emphasize clarity, brevity, and task-tracker compatibility.
- Includes templates, example prompts, and clear DO/DON'T guidance for reliable, high-quality minutes.
